highlights.title: They Got Baited by a Skeleton
highlights.reason: An incredibly funny and suspenseful moment where the players think they have finally found another active player, only to realize someone put a nametag on a skeleton to troll them.

highlights.title: Defeated by a Minecraft Llama
highlights.reason: A hilarious reaction segment where a player is unexpectedly attacked and nearly killed by a spitting llama, forcing him to embarrassingly box himself in for safety.

highlights.title: Making Friends (Or Enemies) in Chat
highlights.reason: A highly engaging conversation where they try to befriend a random player in chat, leading to a funny argument about whether they should betray and rob him instead.

highlights.title: Returning to my Abandoned Server
highlights.reason: An extremely strong hook that sets up the premise of the video: returning to a Minecraft server abandoned six years ago to find active players still waiting.

highlights.title: Undercover as MrBeast
highlights.reason: The suspense builds as the game loads, followed by the exciting reveal of his plan to go undercover in disguise and eventually drop the bombshell that he is MrBeast.

highlights.title: The 20,000 Block Journey Begins
highlights.reason: A great cliffhanger hook where a player gives them coordinates to meet up, but they realize they are an impossible 20,000 blocks away.

highlights.title: Six Years of Destruction
highlights.reason: An intriguing look at how civilization on the server has evolved, showing blown-up ruins and discussing the state of the server six years later.

highlights.title: Welcome to Anarchy Minecraft
highlights.reason: The realization that the server has deteriorated into a rules-free anarchy wasteland with endless roads, ruins, and absolutely no resources left.

highlights.title: We Found Ancient Ruins... Sort Of
highlights.reason: A funny anti-climactic moment where the team gets incredibly hyped to explore a mysterious base, only to discover absolutely nothing inside after an hour of walking.

highlights.title: No Admin Powers Allowed
highlights.reason: The creator explains that he no longer owns the server and must survive exactly like a normal player, adding stakes and grounding the survival aspect.
